sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety. Selected arXiv:2607.14890v1 from the unified table because it is current-week, non-duplicate, agent-lifecycle focused, and has concrete control-policy ablation evidence.

Deep read extracted agent-as-claim semantics, admissible evidence formula, lifecycle gate matrix, receipt tamper contract, 9,240-cell ablation, recovery pilot, corpus evidence, and cross-vendor boundary.
Article flags limitations: local-key trust scope, single model family, task concentration, self-built corpus, selective cross-vendor review, and no proven PR-less production auto-merge.
